evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback is opposed to a rollback one actually has — matched structure ('a rollback … is a rollback …') crystallizing the rule.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker crystallizing a rule into matched opposed clauses so that the second clause negates the first's premise?
